summary: Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. filed an 8-K to correct a clerical error in its Third Amended and Restated Bylaws, which were previously filed as Exhibit 3.5 to its Annual Report on Form 10-K. The original exhibit inadvertently included certain provisions related to shareholder voting that are not part of the Bylaws; the Company is filing the correct copy as Exhibit 3.1. No other disclosures are changed. This is a routine administrative correction with no special situation or corporate event.
